Name: Sprinkler Activation
Author: Socke97
Description:
This is an update to the open-source mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3097]Better Activate Sprinklers[/url]﻿ written by [b]ChaosEnergy[/b], which wasn't updated in a long time.
Sprinklers activated by this mod water both dirt and pots.

[size=5]Install
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]
You can configure activation on player action and placement in the config.json file. Both options are turned on by default.


[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with multiplayer and singleplayer
[*]Should work with "Better Sprinklers", "Line Sprinklers Redux", "Simple Sprinkler" and "Prismatic Tools"
[*]SMAPI 4.0, tested using Stardew Valley version 1.6
[/list]
[size=5]Source
[/size]
